notes.title: The region fix, and a note on every build
notes.goal: The translation layer can adopt the JIT region the app has already secured, so guest libraries can load -- and every build now opens with a note like this one saying what it is for.
details: This is the build that should finally get a Unity title past 0 frames.
In the log, look for 'jni: libjavacore.so JNI_OnLoad' and for the failed to initialize Java/lang/System message to be gone.
If the region still cannot be reached, the log names that failure by name instead of quietly reporting no arena.
From now on every build opens with a short note like this one, and it is re-readable under Settings, This Build.

notes.title: The engine can use the JIT region
notes.goal: The translation layer now reaches the JIT region directly instead of looking it up by name, so it can finally open its arena.
details: Guest libraries can load for the first time, which is what makes java.lang.System initialise.
If the region still cannot be reached, the log now names that failure instead of quietly reporting no arena.
Removed a dead fallback that decoded hardcoded offsets from the old emulator dylib -- those were a crash risk.

notes.title: StikDebug is reachable again
notes.goal: The hand-off to StikDebug no longer depends on a permission check that LiveContainer breaks.
details: Opening stikjit:// is now attempted for real, and iOS own answer is what is reported.
A refused scheme query is treated as "cannot tell" rather than "not installed".
The attach request goes to StikDebug when running inside LiveContainer, where the built-in helper cannot work.

notes.title: The JIT latch is gone
notes.goal: One failed JIT probe at launch no longer uses up this launch only chance at a JIT region.
details: A failed probe is now remembered as "nothing answered yet" instead of "give up", so the claim is retried up to 3 times and each attempt names itself in the log.
A debugger that actively refuses is still never asked twice.
The app now asks for a real attach once per launch instead of trusting a flag.

notes.title: Downloads tile is back
notes.goal: The 3.0 port is done, and the way to download apps from your computer is visible again.
details: Home shows an always-there Downloads card with a live status line, reading "Up to date" when nothing is happening.
A second one sits on the Library screen.
The old emulator engine (QEMU) was removed, so the app is about 8% smaller.
